original.text: yatkṛpāleśamātreṇa puruṣārthacatuṣṭayam | prāpyate tamahaṃ vande govindaṃ bhaktavatsalam ||

paraphrase: Salutation to Govinda, affectionate to devotees, by a mere particle of whose grace the four aims of life are attained.
notes: Checked against the local ebhāratī e-text of the Mīmāṃsānyāyaprakāśa.

paraphrase: This dharma, performed with the aim for which it is enjoined, is the cause of that; performed with the thought of offering it to Śrī Govinda, it is the cause of the highest good — the Gītā verse on offering all acts to the Lord being the authority.
notes: Checked against the local ebhāratī e-text of the Mīmāṃsānyāyaprakāśa. No original (e-text misprint 'budhyā'). The Arthasaṅgraha repeats this with 'Īśvara' for 'Govinda'.
